goal.text: Clear every armful of clothing out of the bedroom and into the one bag, and know when the last load is in so she can leave the room.

turns.text: One hand or both, putting it down?

trigger.detail: the bag is set down and released at the side of the living room

expected_answer.text: Both hands. You carried it by the handles in your right and steadied the side with your left.

turns.text: So where's it sitting now, exactly?

trigger.detail: both hands come off the bag and she turns away from it

expected_answer.text: On the low table at the side of the living room, where you walked it over to.

turns.text: Okay — what did I just lean down and grab?

trigger.detail: she stops on the way to the bedroom and leans forward over the seat

expected_answer.text: A pile of clothes. You picked them up with your right hand and then took them in both.

turns.text: hold on — was that the same spot I took the first load from?

trigger.detail: she second-guesses where this armful came from

expected_answer.text: No. The first load came off the sofa in the living room; this one you took from the seat in the bedroom.

turns.text: Anyway — the bag; where's it ended up now?

trigger.detail: she lifts the bag off the table with both hands and sets it down again

expected_answer.text: You've just moved it onto the couch, carrying it off the table with both hands.

turns.text: mm-hm... mm — actually, how many loads have gone in so far?

trigger.detail: halfway through the window she wants a running total

expected_answer.text: Two so far. One off the sofa at the start, then the armful you carried through from the bedroom.

trigger.detail: she straightens up after emptying her arms into the bag

expected_answer.text: Will do. I'll keep count of each armful as it goes in.

turns.text: which room have I been ferrying these out of?

trigger.detail: she cuts in over the acknowledgement to check the route

expected_answer.text: The bedroom. You've been going back and forth to a seat just inside it and bringing armfuls out to the living area.

turns.text: Is that the last armful, or is there more?

trigger.detail: the final armful goes into the bag and she straightens up

expected_answer.text: That was the last armful. You've straightened up, and from here you head for the bedroom instead of the seat.

turns.text: oh — by the way, what did I just scoop up off the floor in here?

trigger.detail: the couch and the bag drop out of view as she leans over the bedroom floor

expected_answer.text: Some brochures. You grabbed them off the floor with your right hand, then kept one in your left while lifting the bags.
